user.title: Geely
user.description: Geely emails a one-time code. It does not use a password. South African cars on the international app sign in with United Kingdom, which is the default.

code.title: Email code
code.description: Enter the code from the email. Request it only once. A second request too soon is refused and the first code stops working.

init.title: How often to read the car
init.description: While the engine is on or the car is charging, and while it is parked. A parked car does not upload a new position, and this read does not wake it.

data.active_seconds: Seconds between reads while driving or charging

error.cannot_send: Geely did not send a code. Wait a couple of minutes and try once.
error.invalid_auth: Sign-in was refused. Check the email and country.
error.region: This car is registered in an area the published client cannot sign.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.
abort.cannot_send: Geely did not send a code. Wait a couple of minutes and start re-authentication again.
abort.region: This car is registered in an area the published client cannot sign.
